نستألف (form X)
# نَسْتَأْلِفُ (nastaʔlifu) /nas.taʔ.li.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# نَسْتَأْلِفَ (nastaʔlifa) /nas.taʔ.li.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# نَسْتَأْلِفْ (nastaʔlif) /nas.taʔ.lif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
